subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat message actions ship first as Copy and Select Copy only, or should this issue include Share and Reply in the same long-press action sheet?
rationale: The central copy/select gap is source-proven, but the issue proposes extra actions that affect composer behavior, Android intents, and UI scope; maintainers need to choose the product boundary before a safe implementation PR.

options.title: Copy/Select Copy first
options.body: Implement the central reuse workflow with whole-message copy and selective-copy dialog, leaving Share and Reply as follow-up items if maintainers still want them.

options.title: Full action sheet
options.body: Ship Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply together, accepting the larger Android UI, composer, intent, and validation surface.

options.title: Defer or decline
options.body: Keep Android chat text non-selectable beyond code blocks until maintainers decide the added interaction surface is worth the mobile UX complexity.

recommendation.title: Copy/Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Implement the central reuse workflow with whole-message copy and selective-copy dialog, leaving Share and Reply as follow-up items if maintainers still want them.

likelyOwner.reason: They show up in recent Android chat/Markdown history and are the best available routing candidate for the product-scope choice.
